mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.5% percent over 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE stays below 6.5% or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When demand growth (GDPC1) outpaces supply growth (INDPRO), indicating strong absorption of demand, this signals robust economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > INDPRO growth in 1 month
failure_condition: The demand-supply gap does not widen or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in FEDFUNDS below 2% signals a soft landing, reducing policy tightness and boosting investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS do not fall below 2% in such regimes, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS do not stay above 4.5% or 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 100 signals weak supply-side activity, constraining corporate production and earnings, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 100 or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) alongside falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 100k and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: Labor market conditions do not strengthen or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand (GDPC1 exceeding 16,000) signals robust economic activity, driving up stock prices and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not exceed 16,000 or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
